spec_match.rationale: The @supports/JS progressive-enhancement pattern correctly gates on row-rule, but four probe cards labelled '(grid)'/'in flex' actually test multicol column-rule (true everywhere, proving nothing about layout context), and the 'gap-rule' shorthand probe conflicts with the conformance suite's canonical `rule` shorthand vocabulary.

interactive.rationale: The probe grid runs real CSS.supports calls live, but everything is auto-run — there is no user-drivable control anywhere on the page.

blurb_alignment.rationale: The index card promises a repeat() syntax probe, but no repeat() probe exists in the PROBES list; the rest (supports probes, native-vs-fallback, @supports pattern) matches.

edge_cases.rationale: The unsupported branch is honestly displayed per probe (row-* show UNSUPPORTED here) and the fallback panels render, but the mislabeled column-* probes claim grid/flex support this browser does not have.

references.rationale: No references or see-also section at all — the chromestatus.com/feature/5157805733183488 link required by invariant 3 is missing.

conformance.rationale: The feature suite covers the real surface and honestly fails 6 of 8 here; notably it uses the `rule` shorthand where this page probes `gap-rule`.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Verified via headless Chromium 141 cloud fallback (full-page screenshot + DOM, not chrome-devtools-mcp): probe cards render green column-*/red row-* states, native panels show rule-less layouts beside bordered fallbacks, conformance panel 2/6/0; no interactions existed to drive.

telemetry_health.rationale: Baseline injected telemetry only; probe outcomes are not emitted as assert events.

design_system.rationale: Colours are variables, but body/badge text runs 0.5–0.58rem (≈8–9px), well below legible size for probe verdicts and code snippets.

accessibility.rationale: Probe results are text+colour badges (good) but injected with no live region, headings structure is fine, yet the ≈8px type and colour-paired badges make verdicts hard to perceive for low-vision users.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Panels collapse at 560px and snippets scroll horizontally; clean at 1280px headless, but the tiny type would be illegible on a 360px DPR3 screen (untested here).

openQuestions.title: Relabel or replace the context-claiming column-rule probes
openQuestions.detail: CSS.supports cannot test 'column-rule (grid)' or 'column-rule in flex' — the declaration parses via multicol in every browser, so those cards show SUPPORTED here while the grid/flex panels render no rules. Either relabel them 'column-rule parses (multicol-era)' or replace with probes that actually distinguish the gap-decorations surface (row-rule-*, rule shorthand), and derive the grid/flex context claim from a rendered measurement (e.g. compare getComputedStyle or pixel-sample a rule in a grid).

openQuestions.title: Add the missing ChromeStatus reference link
openQuestions.detail: The page has no references/see-also section at all; invariant 3 requires chromestatus.com/feature/5157805733183488 as the self-heal anchor.

openQuestions.title: Reconcile 'gap-rule' with the spec's `rule` shorthand
openQuestions.detail: The page probes `gap-rule: 2px solid red` while the immutable conformance suite (and the rule-builder concept) use the css-gaps-1 `rule` shorthand. Verify the shipped shorthand name in the spec and Chromium source; if `gap-rule` was a stale draft name, update the probe and the blurb so the lab never reports UNSUPPORTED for a syntax the browser does support under its real name.

openQuestions.title: Add the promised repeat() probe or fix the blurb
openQuestions.detail: The feature-index card says the lab probes the repeat() rule syntax; the PROBES array has no repeat() entry. Add e.g. column-rule: repeat(2, 1px solid black) (verified against the spec grammar) or drop the claim.

openQuestions.title: Raise the microscopic type
openQuestions.detail: Probe card headers, badges and snippets are set at 0.5–0.58rem (≈8–9px) — below any legible threshold, especially on mobile. Bring body/badge text to at least 0.7rem and verify AA contrast at that size.

summary: Reviewed with the headless-Chromium-141 cloud fallback (not chrome-devtools-mcp): full-page screenshot + DOM of /v149/css-gap-decorations/compatibility-lab/ and the feature /conformance/ route (HTTP 200; panel 2 pass / 6 fail / 0 blocked). The lab's bottom half (progressive-enhancement pattern gating on row-rule) is exactly right, and row-rule/gap-rule probes honestly read UNSUPPORTED here — but the column-rule probes claim grid/flex context they cannot test and show green over rule-less panels, the page lacks any ChromeStatus reference, the promised repeat() probe is absent, and the type size is ≈8px. No user controls existed to drive.
